name: M3_PMS100MI_SelOrderHead
description: Retrieve released manufacturing order headers based on flexible selection criteria, returning high-level information such as company, facility, warehouse, manufacturing order number, product and description, reference order links, order status, priorities, quantities, key dates and times, scheduling details, configuration numbers and project references. Does not return material or operation lines. Use selection filters to focus on specific production areas or time windows, for example by facility, warehouse, warehouse group, planning area, order status range, or planning horizon around a given date and time.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number in which manufacturing orders are selected.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility from which manufacturing orders are selected.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse used to restrict which manufacturing orders are selected.

inputParameters.name: FSTS
inputParameters.description: From manufacturing order status in the status range used to select orders.

inputParameters.name: TSTS
inputParameters.description: To manufacturing order status in the status range used to select orders.

inputParameters.name: WHGR
inputParameters.description: Warehouse group used instead of individual warehouses to select manufacturing orders.

inputParameters.name: REAR
inputParameters.description: Planning area used to restrict which manufacturing orders are included in the selection.

inputParameters.name: DATE
inputParameters.description: Start date of the scheduling horizon used when selecting manufacturing orders.

inputParameters.name: TIME
inputParameters.description: Start time of the scheduling horizon used when selecting manufacturing orders.

inputParameters.name: SCHH
inputParameters.description: Number of days in the scheduling horizon from the specified start date and time.

inputParameters.name: APIP
inputParameters.description: APS policy controlling which manufacturing orders are included based on advanced planning rules.

inputParameters.name: OPCO
inputParameters.description: Option for checking completed operations when selecting orders (currently not used).

inputParameters.name: SLEN
inputParameters.description: Indicator specifying whether only end-product manufacturing orders are selected.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.

outputParameters.name: MFNO
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item on the order.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Description of the manufactured product.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Category indicating the source type of the reference order linked to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RORN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number linked to the manufacturing order, such as a customer, purchase, or work order.

outputParameters.name: RORL
outputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order associated with the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RORX
outputParameters.description: Suffix used to distinguish sub-lines on the reference order line.

outputParameters.name: WHST
outputParameters.description: Current status of the manufacturing order in the production process.

outputParameters.name: MFCD
outputParameters.description: Higher-level manufacturing order number within the order structure, if applicable.

outputParameters.name: ORQT
outputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the manufacturing order in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: MAQT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated manufactured quantity for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: PRIO
outputParameters.description: Priority of the manufacturing order for planning and scheduling.

outputParameters.name: STDT
outputParameters.description: Planned start date of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MSTI
outputParameters.description: Planned start time of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: FIDT
outputParameters.description: Planned finish date of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MFTI
outputParameters.description: Planned finish time of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: NNDT
outputParameters.description: Alternate planning date proposed by the system when rescheduling the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: PULD
outputParameters.description: Pull-up control used for delayed manufacturing orders in advanced planning and scheduling.

outputParameters.name: PULN
outputParameters.description: Pull-up control used for non-delayed manufacturing orders in advanced planning and scheduling.

outputParameters.name: RIFD
outputParameters.description: Filter date from which reschedule-in proposals are evaluated for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: ROFD
outputParameters.description: Filter date from which reschedule-out proposals are evaluated for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: CLGP
outputParameters.description: Color group used to visually categorize the manufacturing order in the scheduling workbench.

outputParameters.name: TSDA
outputParameters.description: System timestamp date for the manufacturing order record.

outputParameters.name: TSTE
outputParameters.description: System timestamp time for the manufacturing order record.

outputParameters.name: TXT1
outputParameters.description: Free text line 1 for the manufacturing order header.

outputParameters.name: TXT2
outputParameters.description: Free text line 2 for the manufacturing order header.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the manufacturing order header was last changed.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Change number associated with the latest update of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: CHID
outputParameters.description: User ID who last changed the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: SUBN
outputParameters.description: Sub-network identifier used to group the manufacturing order within a planning network.

outputParameters.name: PRAP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing order has been processed by the advanced planning and scheduling tool.

outputParameters.name: HDPR
outputParameters.description: Main product number associated with the manufacturing order, if any.

outputParameters.name: DUED
outputParameters.description: Due date when the manufacturing order is planned to be completed or delivered.

outputParameters.name: RGDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the manufacturing order was created.

outputParameters.name: RGTM
outputParameters.description: Time when the manufacturing order was created.

outputParameters.name: ACTP
outputParameters.description: Planning action message indicating suggested actions for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: NTWP
outputParameters.description: External network priority used when integrating the manufacturing order with external planning tools.

outputParameters.name: ACHD
outputParameters.description: Date when the manufacturing order was last changed by the advanced planning and scheduling tool.

outputParameters.name: ACHT
outputParameters.description: Time when the manufacturing order was last changed by the advanced planning and scheduling tool.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the manufactured product is produced or stored.

outputParameters.name: BASP
outputParameters.description: Surplus distribution priority controlling how excess quantities from the manufacturing order are shared within a batch.

outputParameters.name: ORTY
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order type controlling processing rules and default settings for the order.

outputParameters.name: DCCD
outputParameters.description: Number of decimal places used for quantities on the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: ATNR
outputParameters.description: Attribute number identifying a configured attribute attached to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: TIHM
outputParameters.description: Time when the last transaction for the manufacturing order was performed, expressed in hours and minutes.

outputParameters.name: SCHN
outputParameters.description: Schedule number grouping the manufacturing order in production planning.

outputParameters.name: PRHL
outputParameters.description: Top-level product number at the highest level of the product structure for this order.

outputParameters.name: MFHL
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number at the highest level in the order structure.

outputParameters.name: PRLO
outputParameters.description: Product number at the overlying level directly above this order's product in the product structure.

outputParameters.name: MFLO
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number of the next higher-level parent order.

outputParameters.name: PCCO
outputParameters.description: Process code classifying the manufacturing order, for example discrete, process, or pack order.

outputParameters.name: PINR
outputParameters.description: Process item number identifying the process definition applied to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User responsible for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: PROJ
outputParameters.description: Project number associated with the manufacturing order, if project-controlled.

outputParameters.name: ELNO
outputParameters.description: Project element linked to the manufacturing order within the project structure.

outputParameters.name: WODP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether order documents have been printed for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: TX40
outputParameters.description: Short description text for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: STRT
outputParameters.description: Product structure type used for the manufactured item on the order.

outputParameters.name: MACN
outputParameters.description: Identifier referencing the macro order grouping this manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MAUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the manufacturing order quantity is expressed.

outputParameters.name: CFIN
outputParameters.description: Configuration number uniquely identifying the product configuration for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: AOID
outputParameters.description: Alternate routing ID for the manufacturing order (field currently not used).

outputParameters.name: SCNB
outputParameters.description: Supply chain number identifying the end-to-end supply chain to which the manufacturing order belongs.

outputParameters.name: MONO
outputParameters.description: Macro order number assigned from the macro order number series.

outputParameters.name: MFPC
outputParameters.description: Process identifier referencing the process product structure used for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: EXRN
outputParameters.description: External reference number storing an ID from an external system for this manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: EXD2
outputParameters.description: Free-text description of the external reference linked to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: BAQT
outputParameters.description: Actual yield quantity reported for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MEXP
outputParameters.description: Manual expiration date overriding the calculated expiration date for the manufactured lot, if set.

outputParameters.name: EXPI
outputParameters.description: Calculated expiration date for the manufactured item and lot.

outputParameters.name: RBQT
outputParameters.description: Remaining quantity to be produced or reported for the manufacturing order in the basic unit of measure.
